encapsulate.en: The three principles encapsulate the central argument of the study.
encapsulate.zh: 这三条原则概括了研究的核心论点。

encapsulate.en: A single memorable phrase can encapsulate an entire theory.
encapsulate.zh: 一个令人难忘的短语就能浓缩一整套理论。

encapsulate.en: These abstracts encapsulate the findings for busy administrators.
encapsulate.zh: 这些摘要浓缩了研究结论，方便忙碌的管理者阅读。

collapse.en: The old bridge collapsed after the flood weakened its foundations.
collapse.zh: 洪水削弱了旧桥的地基，桥随后倒塌了。

collapse.en: Talks collapsed when the two governments refused to compromise.
collapse.zh: 由于两国政府拒绝妥协，谈判破裂了。

collapse.en: Under the weight of snow the tent collapsed in seconds.
collapse.zh: 在积雪的重压下，帐篷几秒内就塌了。

virtually.en: Virtually every student in the course completed the final survey.
virtually.zh: 课程中几乎每个学生都完成了最终问卷。

virtually.en: Students can walk through a virtually reconstructed forum and inspect each building in detail.
virtually.zh: 学生可以穿行于虚拟重建的古广场，逐栋细看每座建筑。

virtually.en: Online collaboration has virtually replaced many local meetings.
virtually.zh: 在线协作实际上已经取代了许多线下会议。

advantageous.en: It is advantageous to submit the application before the deadline.
advantageous.zh: 在截止日期前提交申请是有利的。

advantageous.en: The university offers advantageous terms for students from partner schools.
advantageous.zh: 该校为合作学校的学生提供优惠条件。

advantageous.en: Living near campus proved advantageous during the busy recruitment season.
advantageous.zh: 在招聘旺季住在校园附近被证明很有好处。

denote.en: In this table the symbol denotes a missing measurement.
denote.zh: 在此表格中，该符号表示数据缺失。

denote.en: The blue line denotes the boundary of the study area.
denote.zh: 蓝线表示研究区域的边界。

denote.en: Such terms often denote concepts that resist simple definition.
denote.zh: 这类术语往往表示难以简单定义的概念。

schematic.en: The schematic diagram shows every connection in the circuit.
schematic.zh: 这张示意图显示电路中的每一处连接。

schematic.en: A schematic drawing is more useful than a detailed plan here.
schematic.zh: 在这里，示意图比详细图纸更有用。

schematic.en: The report provides a schematic overview of the entire procedure.
schematic.zh: 该报告对整个流程给出了概略的说明。

diagram.en: Please label the components in the diagram before submission.
diagram.zh: 提交前请在图中标注各个部件。

diagram.en: The diagram illustrates how heat moves through the material.
diagram.zh: 这张图解说明了热量如何在材料中传导。

diagram.en: She drew a simple diagram to clarify the argument for students.
diagram.zh: 她画了一张简图，为学生澄清这一论点。

onerous.en: Preparing the annual report proved more onerous than expected.
onerous.zh: 准备年度报告被证明比预想的更加繁重。

onerous.en: The reviewers faced the onerous task of reading hundreds of submissions.
onerous.zh: 评审们面临阅读数百份投稿这一艰巨任务。

onerous.en: Current regulations place an onerous burden on small laboratories.
onerous.zh: 现行规定给小型实验室带来了沉重的负担。

inclined.en: Few economists are inclined to believe the trend will reverse soon.
inclined.zh: 很少有经济学家倾向于相信这一趋势会很快逆转。

inclined.en: She is inclined to accept the offer despite the modest salary.
inclined.zh: 尽管薪水不高，她仍倾向于接受这份工作。

inclined.en: The committee was inclined to postpone the decision until further evidence arrived.
inclined.zh: 委员会倾向于推迟决定，直到更多证据到来。

nevertheless.en: The method is complex; nevertheless, it produces highly reliable results.
nevertheless.zh: 这种方法很复杂，但它仍能产生非常可靠的结果。

nevertheless.en: Nevertheless, the authors acknowledge two significant limitations in their model.
nevertheless.zh: 尽管如此，作者承认其模型存在两项重大局限。

nevertheless.en: The evidence is limited, but nevertheless it points in one direction.
nevertheless.zh: 证据有限，但它仍指向同一个方向。

criterion.en: Cost efficiency was the main criterion used to rank the proposals.
criterion.zh: 成本效益是用于对提案排序的主要标准。

criterion.en: Applicants must meet every criterion listed in the official guidelines.
criterion.zh: 申请人必须满足官方指南中列出的每一项标准。

criterion.en: The committee revised its criterion for awarding the scholarship.
criterion.zh: 委员会修订了授予奖学金的标准。

owe.en: The discovery owes much to decades of careful fieldwork.
owe.zh: 这一发现很大程度上要归功于数十年的细致田野调查。

owe.en: She owes her career to a chance encounter with an advisor.
owe.zh: 她把职业生涯归功于与一位导师的一次偶遇。

owe.en: The early results owe much to better laboratory equipment.
owe.zh: 早期结果很大程度上得益于更好的实验设备。

evaluate.en: We must evaluate the risks before adopting the new method.
evaluate.zh: 采用新方法之前我们必须评估风险。

evaluate.en: The panel will evaluate each application against published standards.
evaluate.zh: 评审小组将依据公布的标准评估每一份申请。

evaluate.en: Researchers evaluate the data with statistical software to ensure accuracy.
evaluate.zh: 研究人员使用统计软件评估数据，以确保准确性。

arise.en: New ethical questions arise whenever the technology is applied in schools.
arise.zh: 该技术应用于学校时，总会产生新的伦理问题。

arise.en: The opportunity to collaborate arose unexpectedly during the conference.
arise.zh: 在会议期间，合作的机会出人意料地出现了。

arise.en: A separate dispute arose between the two departments last spring.
arise.zh: 去年春天两个部门之间又起了一场争端。

indicate.en: The temperature curve indicates a rapid warming over the past decade.
indicate.zh: 温度曲线显示过去 10 年快速升温。

indicate.en: Her tone indicated that further discussion would be unwelcome.
indicate.zh: 她的语气表明进一步的讨论不会受欢迎。

indicate.en: Figures indicate that most participants preferred the online format.
indicate.zh: 数据表明大多数参与者更喜欢线上形式。

cutting-edge.en: The laboratory uses cutting-edge imaging to observe cellular processes.
cutting-edge.zh: 该实验室使用前沿的成像技术观察细胞过程。

cutting-edge.en: Cutting-edge research has transformed our understanding of the disease.
cutting-edge.zh: 最前沿的研究改变了我们对该疾病的认识。

cutting-edge.en: Her lecture covered several cutting-edge developments in artificial intelligence.
cutting-edge.zh: 她的讲座介绍了人工智能领域的若干尖端进展。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the applications received external review.
fraction.zh: 只有一小部分申请获得了外部评审。

fraction.en: The result improved by a fraction of a percentage point.
fraction.zh: 结果提高的幅度还不到一个百分点的零头。

fraction.en: She spent only a fraction of the budget on laboratory equipment.
fraction.zh: 她只用了预算的一小部分购置实验设备。

endowed with.en: The region is endowed with rich mineral resources and abundant rainfall.
endowed with.zh: 该地区拥有丰富的矿产资源和充足的降雨。

endowed with.en: Students endowed with curiosity often become the most productive researchers.
endowed with.zh: 天生具备好奇心的学生往往成为最高产的研究者。

endowed with.en: This species is endowed with an unusually strong immune system.
endowed with.zh: 这一物种天生具有异常强大的免疫系统。

progressively.en: As the sample grew, the estimates progressively converged toward the predicted value.
progressively.zh: 随着样本增加，估计值逐步收敛到预测值。

progressively.en: The disease has progressively weakened the animal's ability to forage.
progressively.zh: 这种疾病逐渐削弱了该动物觅食的能力。

progressively.en: Costs have risen progressively since the program began in 2019.
progressively.zh: 自 2019 年项目启动以来，成本日益攀升。

immensely.en: The discovery has immensely improved our understanding of early oceans.
immensely.zh: 这一发现极大地提升了我们对早期海洋的认识。

immensely.en: Her meticulous preparation contributed immensely to the project's success.
immensely.zh: 她一丝不苟的准备对项目的成功作出了极大贡献。

immensely.en: The online archive is immensely valuable to researchers across many disciplines.
immensely.zh: 该在线档案对众多学科的研究人员极为宝贵。

suppress.en: Certain chemicals can suppress plant growth when applied in excess.
suppress.zh: 某些化学物质使用过量时会抑制植物生长。

suppress.en: The editor suppressed the inflammatory passages from the final manuscript.
suppress.zh: 编辑从最终稿中删去了那些煽动性的段落。

suppress.en: Try to suppress your frustration when the deadline is moved again.
suppress.zh: 当截止日期再次变动时，尽量压住你的沮丧情绪。

profoundly.en: The discovery profoundly altered how scientists understood plant communication.
profoundly.zh: 这一发现深刻地改变了科学家对植物交流方式的理解。

profoundly.en: Her work profoundly influenced the design of modern irrigation systems.
profoundly.zh: 她的工作深刻影响了现代灌溉系统的设计。

profoundly.en: The policy change had a profoundly negative effect on small businesses.
profoundly.zh: 这项政策变动对小企业产生了极为负面的影响。

exemplify.en: These cases exemplify the wider trends documented across the industry.
exemplify.zh: 这些案例体现了整个行业中更为广泛的趋势。

exemplify.en: Her career exemplifies what a lifelong commitment to research can achieve.
exemplify.zh: 她的职业生涯体现了毕生投入研究能够取得的成就。

exemplify.en: I will exemplify the argument with two recent field studies.
exemplify.zh: 我将用两项最新的田野研究来举例说明这一论点。

illustrative.en: The following table is illustrative only and does not show every case.
illustrative.zh: 下面的表格仅作说明之用，并未涵盖所有情况。

illustrative.en: We selected several illustrative examples from the survey responses.
illustrative.zh: 我们从问卷回答中挑选了几个具有例证说明作用的例子。

illustrative.en: The case is highly illustrative of how local institutions resist reform.
illustrative.zh: 这一案例极好地说明了地方机构如何抵制改革。

cornerstone.en: Trust between researchers remains the cornerstone of any successful collaboration.
cornerstone.zh: 研究者之间的信任仍是任何成功合作的基石。

cornerstone.en: The cornerstone of the reform strategy was improved access to public records.
cornerstone.zh: 改革策略的基石是更好地获取公共档案。

cornerstone.en: Early language education forms the cornerstone of later academic achievement.
cornerstone.zh: 早期语言教育是日后学业成就的奠基石。

discard.en: Reviewers should discard preliminary notes that no longer support the argument.
discard.zh: 评审者应当丢弃不再支持论点的初步笔记。

discard.en: The engineers discarded the design because it exceeded the weight limit.
discard.zh: 工程师们弃用了那个设计，因为它超过了重量限制。

discard.en: It is wise to discard outdated assumptions before beginning the analysis.
discard.zh: 在开始分析之前，明智的做法是抛弃过时的假设。

provisional.en: The figures are provisional and will be revised after the audit.
provisional.zh: 这些数据是暂定的，将在审计后修订。

provisional.en: The council issued a provisional ban on construction near the wetland.
provisional.zh: 市议会发布了一项针对湿地附近施工的临时禁令。

provisional.en: A provisional agreement was reached before the formal negotiation began.
provisional.zh: 在正式谈判开始前，双方达成了初步协议。

temporary.en: The laboratory was housed in a temporary building during the renovation.
temporary.zh: 翻修期间实验室设在一栋临时建筑里。

temporary.en: This solution provides only a temporary fix for the underlying problem.
temporary.zh: 这种办法只是对根本问题的临时修补。

temporary.en: The clinic operates from a temporary site until the new wing opens.
temporary.zh: 在新楼翼启用前，诊所在临时场所运营。

temporal.en: The study examines temporal changes in vegetation over three decades.
temporal.zh: 该研究考察了 30 年来植被的时间变化。

temporal.en: Temporal resolution determines how precisely the instrument can record events.
temporal.zh: 时间分辨率决定了仪器记录事件的精确程度。

temporal.en: The model accounts for both spatial and temporal variability in rainfall.
temporal.zh: 该模型同时考虑了降水的空间变异和时间变异。

distinctive.en: The species has a distinctive call that researchers use to identify it.
distinctive.zh: 该物种有独特的叫声，研究者据此识别它。

distinctive.en: Her distinctive approach earned her a place on the editorial board.
distinctive.zh: 她独特的方法使她得以进入编辑委员会。

distinctive.en: Each region has a distinctive architectural style that reflects its history.
distinctive.zh: 每个地区都有反映其历史的独特建筑风格。

distinct.en: There is a distinct difference between correlation and causation in the data.
distinct.zh: 数据中相关性与因果性之间存在明显区别。

distinct.en: It is distinct from other studies because it follows participants for ten years.
distinct.zh: 它与其他研究明显不同，因为它跟踪参与者 10 年。

distinct.en: The two treatments produced distinct effects on plant growth rates.
distinct.zh: 这两种处理方式对植物生长速率产生了明显不同的影响。

harbor.en: The new law may harbor hidden risks for small businesses.
harbor.zh: 这项新法律可能潜藏着小企业面临的风险。

harbor.en: The dataset may harbor subtle errors that routine checks miss.
harbor.zh: 该数据集中可能潜藏着常规检查难以发现的细微错误。

harbor.en: Such criticism harbors little more than a personal grudge against the ministry.
harbor.zh: 这种批评不过是出于对部委的个人不满。
